## What’s new in Pär v0.1.9-beta.2026100804

### Better conversation context

- Chat session context and summaries now stay with the conversation that
  created them, so unrelated memories are less likely to appear in a new chat.
  Explicit memory search remains available across conversations for the same
  household member.

### More reliable Windows Home Hub

- Windows builds now include the Home Hub pairing page and its frontend assets.
  Pairing and Act requests also work more reliably from the desktop webview.
